rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategic themes recur in Key Concepts.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Harm: a module teaching tactics with no worldview underneath. Doc's 'Themes earned' for M4 (line 375): compounding, mirror, 90% correct. Walked all 4 Key Concepts bullets (lines 50-53): bullet 1 ('The audit ranked the thin spots in your setup against one real task. You corrected the ranking, then filled the worst two or three') instances theme 5/capture-your-world — the student's correction of the agent's ranking is the steering move theme 5 names ('your corrections are how it stops guessing'). Three of four bullets clear the rule's 2-3 floor across distinct theme instances; the fourth (pinned-commit-as-experiment, line 53) reinforces the Big Idea rather than an arc theme, which the rule does not require of every bullet.
